# Selected Web Platform Tests

Sources downloaded 2026-11-15 from `web-platform-tests/wpt`, `master`:

- [max-width-001.xht](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/css/CSS2/normal-flow/max-width-001.xht), Microsoft; reviewed by Gérard Talbot. Imported unchanged. The CSS harness checks rejection of the invalid negative maximum and preservation of zero content width. The dashboard also checks the test’s no-red visual assertion across the entire capture. This is not a pixel comparison with its match reference.
- [white-space-pre-001.xht](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/css/CSS2/text/white-space-pre-001.xht), Ian Hickson; reviewed by Gérard Talbot. Imported unchanged. Retained as a pending visual test: its Ahem font and match reference have not been vendored. Do not count it as passing.

Original author/reviewer metadata and reference links remain in each file.
The offline original page fixtures elsewhere in this directory are not WPT tests.
